function.name: run_sql_query
function.arguments:
{"sql": "WITH june_cities AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT country_code_2, CAST(insert_date AS DATE) as ins_date
  FROM cities
  WHERE insert_date >= '2022-06-01' AND insert_date <= '2022-06-30'
),
with_groups AS (
  SELECT country_code_2, ins_date,
    ins_date - (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY ins_date))::INT as grp

),
streaks AS (
  SELECT country_code_2, grp, MIN(ins_date) as streak_start, MAX(ins_date) as streak_end,
    COUNT(*) as streak_length
  FROM with_groups
  GROUP BY country_code_2, grp
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT country_code_2, streak_length,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY streak_length DESC) as rn
  FROM streaks
)
SELECT country_code_2, streak_length, rn FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY streak_length DESC LIMIT 20", "preview_rows": 20}
